name: Celebrity Cruises
notes: Classic drinks ~$90 + 20% service (third-party, Sept 2026); Basic Wi-Fi ~$20/day; specialty dinners $58-67 + 20%. Soft-drink package price not found.

name: Royal Caribbean
notes: Deluxe Beverage Package is priced per sailing (~$56-105 + 18% in 2026 reports); midpoint used. VOOM $16.99-30.99/device/day (official guide). Specialty: Chops $69.99, Giovanni's $54.99 (2024) + 18%.

name: Carnival Cruise Line
notes: CHEERS! $69.95 + 20% pre-cruise; Bottomless Bubbles $11.99 + 20%; Premium (streaming) Wi-Fi $25.50/day pre-cruise. Carnival moves drink and Wi-Fi packages to per-sailing pricing from 2026-12-01. Steakhouse about $52 incl. gratuity.

name: Princess Cruises
notes: Standalone Plus Beverage Package reported at $64.99/day incl. service charge (another source says $77.99). MedallionNet $24.99/day. Crown Grill about $55 + 20%.

name: Holland America Line
notes: Signature Beverage Package from $54.95 + 18% (third-party, undated). Wi-Fi $30.99/day per Holland America's blog comparison. Pinnacle Grill about $52 (third-party).

name: Cunard
notes: Beverage Collection about $75-85.50/day depending on voyage length (third-party, 2026); Wi-Fi from $18/day. New 2026 Signature Packages (~$75/day) bundle drinks, Wi-Fi and dining credit; contents vary, not modeled.

name: Seabourn
notes: All-inclusive: drinks (most wines and spirits), Wi-Fi, gratuities and dining are in the fare, so add-on prices are not needed.
